verdict.rationale: Users can hand tasks to gstack's specialist skills: a router sends any request to the right skill [18], and /qa finds and fixes bugs, committing each fix [2]. /ship merges, tests, reviews, commits and opens a PR [3], and /autoplan runs the review pipeline with auto-decisions [5]. Community users describe the specialist personas working as a team [comm-1, comm-2]. However, the AI is not built into gstack: it is a skill pack that runs inside external host agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor [13, 34], so delegation depends on a separate tool. Missing for 10: a native assistant that runs without an external host agent, and hands-on evidence of end-to-end delegation reliability.
